It does not prescribe risk tolerance and is intended to be flexible and to augment existing risk practices. It provides four core functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, MANAGE. No penalties or enforcement mechanisms are established.","confidence":0.97}

{"safety_requirements":[{"label":"risk_assessment","confidence":0.95,"evidence":[{"quote":"AI risk management efforts should prioritize the minimization of potential negative impacts","source_section":"Page 19"},{"quote":"The AI system is evaluated regularly for safety risks – as identified in the MAP function. The AI system to be deployed is demonstrated to be safe, its residual negative risk does not exceed the risk tolerance","source_section":"Page 35"}]},{"label":"pre_deployment_testing","confidence":0.95,"evidence":[{"quote":"AI systems should be tested before their deployment and regularly while in operation.","source_section":"Page 33"},{"quote":"TEVV tasks for deployment include system validation and integration in production, with testing, and recalibration","source_section":"Page 41"}]},{"label":"human_oversight","confidence":0.9,"evidence":[{"quote":"may need to include human intervention in cases where the AI system cannot detect or correct errors","source_section":"Page 19"},{"quote":"the ability to shut down, modify, or have human intervention into systems that deviate from intended or expected functionality","source_section":"Page 20"}]},{"label":"transparency_disclosure","confidence":0.9,"evidence":[{"quote":"Transparency reflects the extent to which information about an AI system and its outputs is available to individuals interacting with such a system","source_section":"Page 20"},{"quote":"Risks associated with transparency and accountability – as identified in the MAP function – are examined and documented","source_section":"Page 35"}]},{"label":"model_documentation","confidence":0.9,"evidence":[{"quote":"The AI model is explained, validated, and documented, and AI system output is interpreted within its context","source_section":"Page 35"},{"quote":"Accuracy measurements should always be paired with clearly defined and realistic test sets…and details about test methodology; these should be included in associated documentation","source_section":"Page 19"}]},{"label":"incident_reporting","confidence":0.85,"evidence":[{"quote":"Incidents and errors are communicated to relevant AI actors, including affected communities. Processes for tracking, responding to, and recovering from incidents and errors are followed and documented.","source_section":"Page 38"}]},{"label":"third_party_audit","confidence":0.7,"evidence":[{"quote":"Processes for independent review can improve the effectiveness of testing and can mitigate internal biases and potential conflicts of interest","source_section":"Page 33"}]},{"label":"content_provenance","confidence":0.7,"evidence":[{"quote":"Maintaining the provenance of training data and supporting attribution of the AI system's decisions to subsets of training data can assist with both transparency and accountability","source_section":"Page 21"}]},{"label":"access_controls","confidence":0.7,"evidence":[{"quote":"AI systems that can maintain confidentiality, integrity, and availability through protection mechanisms that prevent unauthorized access and use may be said to be secure","source_section":"Page 20"}]}],"enforcement_mechanisms":[{"label":"soft_enforcement","confidence":0.95,"evidence":[{"quote":"AI RMF use-case profiles are implementations of the AI RMF functions, categories, and subcategories for a specific setting or application based on the requirements, risk tolerance, and resources of the Framework user","source_section":"Page 38"},{"quote":"It is incumbent on Framework users to continue applying the MEASURE function to AI systems as knowledge, methodologies, risks, and impacts evolve over time","source_section":"Page 33"}]},{"label":"reporting_obligation","confidence":0.75,"evidence":[{"quote":"Processes for tracking, responding to, and recovering from incidents and errors are followed and documented","source_section":"Page 38"},{"quote":"Post-deployment AI system monitoring plans are implemented, including mechanisms for capturing and evaluating input from users and other relevant AI actors","source_section":"Page 38"}]}]}
